saints.name: St. Denis and Companions
saints.title: Bishop and Martyrs
saints.shortBlurb: The first bishop of Paris, martyred with his companions and honoured as an apostle of Gaul…
biography: Denis (Dionysius) was sent from Rome in the third century to evangelize Gaul and became the first bishop of Paris, preaching from an island in the Seine. With the priest Rusticus and the deacon Eleutherius he gathered a Christian community amid persecution.

During a persecution, most likely under the emperor Valerian about the year 258, the three were arrested, tortured, and beheaded on the hill north of the city long afterward called Montmartre, the “mount of the martyrs.” Denis became one of the great patrons of France, honoured at the royal abbey that bears his name.
saints.knownFor: First bishop of Paris and martyr of Gaul.
